subject: South Medford Connector Section 106 Review
overview: The Historical Commission held a public comment session on the Section 106 review for the South Medford Connector community path, appointed a new liaison to the Brooks Estate Land Trust, and discussed upcoming zoning protections for historic buildings.

items.title: Appointment to MBELT Board
items.summary: Appointed former commissioner Ben Johnson as the commission's liaison to the Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust (MBELT).

items.title: South Medford Connector Section 106 Review
items.summary: Reviewed and received public comments on the proposed MassDOT community path near Route 16 and Route 93, with speakers advocating for safety, mobility, and future passive recreational access to the Mystic River corridor.

items.title: Zoning Update
items.summary: Discussed the draft Boston Avenue and Medford Square zoning reforms, focusing on the future identification and protection of historically significant buildings.

items.title: Hagner Center Demolition Discussion
items.summary: Noted the anticipated demolition application for the Hagner Center and heard resident complaints about safety and dumping on the property.

items.title: Old Business and Updates
items.summary: Reviewed status updates on commission vacancies, school inventory, properties under demo delay, and historical preservation projects at the Brooks Estate, Thomas Brooks Park, Cross Street Cemetery, and Hastings Heights.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from June 2026.
